test_reap_orphaned_browser_sessions: test the _reap_orphaned_browser_sessions function to clean up stale agent-browser socket directories with dead or missing PIDs
test_write_owner_pid: test the _write_owner_pid function to verify it writes the current process PID to the owner_pid file in a socket directory
test_run_browser_command_writes_owner_pi: test _run_browser_command to verify it calls _write_owner_pid after creating the socket directory
test_emergency_cleanup_runs_reaper: test _emergency_cleanup_all_sessions to verify it calls _reap_orphaned_browser_sessions on exit even with no active sessions
test_owner_pid_cross_process_safety: test owner_pid-based cross-process safety to ensure alive owners are not reaped and dead owners trigger cleanup
